methods.source_location: Methodology: Data sources; supplementary Table S1
methods.notes: Recalibration of the Milani PV subset explicitly stated by Angel (2022); this is one component of the multi-source fit.

recalculation.notes: Joint multi-source fit uses source-specific calibrations and refined scale factors. Complete paired calibrant inputs and transformed joint fit project are not recovered.

pressure_calibration.notes: Milani quartz-calibrated PV inputs were recalculated by Angel (2022) from Angel (1997) to Scheidl (2016). Other grossular series use ruby/Au/NaCl as described in supplementary S1; no single substitute pressure scale is assigned.

assessment.basis: Published parameterization verified by independent quadrature and official EosFit checks; complete original joint fit is unavailable.
qualifications: Covariance is source-reported and conditional; no original-fit coefficient or formal-uncertainty reproduction is claimed.

All 52 Gwanmesia rows and the other recovered source tables are available separately. Original Thiéblot measurement errors, exact author volume normalization/anchors, assigned coordinate errors, Isaak expansion specimen processing and original joint-fit confidence/covariance remain unresolved. Diagnostic estimates are not source errors.

scientific_validation.note: Source parameterization and volume conventions independently verified. Complete original joint fit remains unrecovered; this is not author-workflow or experimental validation.

locations: Methodology: EoS models and EoS refinement
primary_source_check.finding: Constant theta0 and gamma/V, BM3 reference at 298 K, fixed molar V0 and 20 atoms per formula unit. Official EOS tokens and all 59x59 covariance entries retained in the source file.

primary_data_check.finding: The eleven recovered source tables and the separately labelled digitized series are available through Material.get_dataset(). They retain anchors, exclusions, specimen identities and unknown source errors. The original author-processed mixed volume/adiabatic-modulus project is still unavailable: exact normalization, assigned coordinate errors, selected-row processing and covariance are unresolved. The 219-row diagnostic includes explicitly estimated errors for 26 observations and does not replace the original project.

numerical_reproduction.finding: Independent SI quadrature agrees over 20 mathematical test states per material; Table 1 derived reference expansivity reproduced. Official EosFit checks retained separately. Calculated checkpoints are not observations.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Joint synthesis of experimental volume and adiabatic bulk-modulus observations, selected for consistency with measured heat capacities; includes adopted fixed molar V0.
parameter_provenance.volume_conversion: Vcell[A3] = Vm[cm3/mol] * 8 * 1e24 / NA, NA=6.02214076e23 mol^-1. Native volume=Vm/10 J/bar/mol.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Inline errors are the unchanged printed Table 1 widths; confidence is unspecified. The source-file covariance is retained independently and is used for propagation. It is conditional on fixed V0 and all source model/selection/calibration assumptions; omitted nuisance scale factors are marginalized by taking the EOS submatrix. No error is invented for adopted V0.
